create_LasrEncoderConfig: create a LasrEncoderConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and conv_kernel_size parameters
create_LasrCTCConfig: create a LasrCTCConfig instance with custom vocab_size, ctc_loss_reduction, and encoder_config settings
build_model_from_config: build a LasrEncoderModel or LasrForCTC model from a LasrEncoderConfig or LasrCTCConfig instance
configure_conformer_params: configure conformer convolution module params including convolution_bias, conv_kernel_size, and conv_residual_weights
configure_subsampling_layers: configure subsampling convolution layer params including channels, kernel_size, and stride for audio feature extraction
